name: Obia
long_description:
OBIA is an AI-native commercial real estate brokerage for industrial and office. We help businesses find their best-fit space, negotiate a competitive deal backed by market data, and get the keys in as little as two weeks.

Finding the right space means evaluating operational fit, zoning, and pricing using information scattered across listings, brochures, municipal codes, maps, and broker conversations. That research can take a broker hours per property. OBIA reduces that work to minutes.

We started with industrial and office properties in California, with plans to expand nationally and into other asset classes. Our goal is to make thorough, responsive commercial real estate representation available to every business.
